scenarios.description: Approved 0200 completes Received→Validated→MacVerified→Routed→ForwardedToSink→Responded and resolves durable recovery snapshot.
Issuer decline is returned once and durable recovery snapshot is resolved; no compensating reversal is generated.
Upstream timeout leaves durable snapshot TimedOut and returns response 91 to source.
Process crash after durable snapshot/ForwardedToSink but before response is recovered after restart by 0420 to the exact original sink.
Accepted recovery reversal transitions lifecycle to Reversed and closes snapshot.
Rejected/empty/error recovery reversal is retry-scheduled using configured backoff and never falsely marked Reversed.
Recovery exceeding MaxAttempts transitions to Failed and raises audit evidence.
Distributed duplicate claim prevents a second financial execution for the same source/STAN/business date.
Open/unavailable primary sink routes to configured fallback sink before STIP is considered.
When all upstream sinks are unavailable, stand-in applies BIN profile, floor and velocity limits and records persistent velocity in SQL mode.
0100 approved hold survives restart; 0220 completion and 0420 void correlate by RRN/STAN and source.
Transaction lifecycle, preauth, stand-in velocity and recovery snapshots are SQL-backed in production and survive engine restart.
Recovery payload is encrypted at rest and contains no clear PAN in TransactionRecoverySnapshots.
Operations API exposes due recovery work without revealing protected reversal payload or PAN.
Migration 042 applies on clean and upgraded SQL Server with FK/index/check constraints intact.
